title: Direct image and its derived functor
statement:
Let $u:U\to V$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. For a scheme $T$ let $T_{\Et}$ be its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] and $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ the abelian category of sheaves of abelian groups on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For an object $W\to V$ of $V_{\Et}$ the fibre product $W\times_VU$ [def-pc-fibre-product], with its projection to $U$, is an object of $U_{\Et}$, and $W\mapsto W\times_VU$, $(g:W_1\to W_2)\mapsto g\times\mathrm{id}_U$, is the base-change functor $V_{\Et}\to U_{\Et}$ [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits].

*Direct image.* For $F\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$ let $u_*F$ be the presheaf of abelian groups on $V_{\Et}$

$$
 (u_*F)(W)=F(W\times_VU),
$$

with restriction along $g:W_1\to W_2$ the restriction of $F$ along $g\times\mathrm{id}_U$; it is a sheaf [lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous]. For a morphism $\varphi:F\to F'$ of $\Ab(U_{\Et})$ put $(u_*\varphi)_W=\varphi_{W\times_VU}$. This defines the *direct image* functor

$$
 u_*:\Ab(U_{\Et})\longrightarrow\Ab(V_{\Et}),
$$

which is additive and left exact [def-sp-left-exact-additive], [lem-weil-pbc-direct-image-left-exact].

*Derived direct image.* Let $\Dplus(T_{\Et})$ be the bounded below derived category of $\Ab(T_{\Et})$, with cohomology sheaves $\mathcal H^q$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], and $Q$ the localization functor from complexes [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]; $\Ab(U_{\Et})$ has enough injectives [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-enough-injectives]. The *derived direct image*

$$
 Ru_*:\Dplus(U_{\Et})\longrightarrow\Dplus(V_{\Et})
$$

is the right derived functor $Rv$ of the additive functor $v=u_*$, together with its natural transformation $\alpha_L:Q(u_*L)\to Ru_*(QL)$ for bounded below complexes $L$, of [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective] (determined up to a unique isomorphism compatible with $\alpha$, by part (3) there). It is computed by K-injective resolutions [def-weil-pbc-kinjective-resolutions]: for $K\in\Dplus(U_{\Et})$ there are a bounded below complex $I$ of injective objects of $\Ab(U_{\Et})$ and an isomorphism $K\cong QI$, and $I$ is K-injective [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative]; then $\alpha_I$ is an isomorphism (part (2) of [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective]), so that

$$
 Ru_*K\cong Q(u_*I),
$$

which is the formula $Ru_*K=u_*I(K)$. For any other K-injective resolution $K\to J$, the isomorphism $QI\cong K\cong QJ$ is $Q(h)$ for a homotopy class $h:I\to J$ which is a homotopy equivalence [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived]; as $u_*$ is additive, $u_*h$ is a homotopy equivalence, so $Q(u_*J)\cong Q(u_*I)\cong Ru_*K$ and the formula holds with every K-injective resolution. On morphisms: for $f:K\to K'$ and $I,I'$ as above, $f$ corresponds under $K\cong QI$, $K'\cong QI'$ to $Q(\tilde f)$ for a unique homotopy class $\tilde f:I\to I'$ [lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived], and by the naturality of $\alpha$, $Ru_*(f)$ corresponds under these isomorphisms to $Q(u_*\tilde f)$. For a sheaf $F\in\Ab(U_{\Et})$, placed in degree $0$, and $q\in\mathbf Z$ put

$$
 R^qu_*F=\mathcal H^q(Ru_*F).
$$

*Module sheaves.* Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $R_T$ the constant sheaf of rings with value $R$ on $T_{\Et}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], $\Mod(T_{\Et},R)$ the abelian category of sheaves of $R_T$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $\Dplus(T_{\Et},R)$ its bounded below derived category [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. The same formula defines the direct image $u_*:\Mod(U_{\Et},R)\to\Mod(V_{\Et},R)$, the module structure of $u_*F$ being given through the map of sheaves of rings $\rho:R_V\to u_*R_U$ induced, by the universal property of sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], by the maps $R\to R_U(W\times_VU)$; it is additive and left exact and commutes with the forgetful functors to abelian sheaves [lem-weil-pbc-module-direct-image-left-exact]. As $\Mod(U_{\Et},R)$ has enough injectives [lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-enough-injectives], $Ru_*:\Dplus(U_{\Et},R)\to\Dplus(V_{\Et},R)$, its computation by K-injective resolutions and $R^qu_*$ are defined in the same way, with [lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective] applied to this $u_*$. (This is the source's 'fixed coefficient ring whose pullback is canonically identified with itself': the constant sheaf $R_V$, whose inverse image is $R_U$.)

split_report.summary: Definition split, checked against Stacks etale-cohomology.tex Section 03PV (Definition 03PY, Remark 03PX: the direct image of a sheaf is a sheaf; the paragraph after 03PY: f_* on abelian sheaves is left exact; Definition 04I2), sites-cohomology.tex Section 071J (left exact f_* on modules and Rf_*: D^+ -> D^+) and derived.tex Lemmas 05TI, 05TH, 070Y. Every notion now cites a node: 'morphism' repointed from the grab-bag def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions to def-pc-scheme; Ab(T_Et) cites def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves (Mathlib leaf) instead of the imported def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves; fibre product def-pc-fibre-product; base-change functor lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits; D^+, H^q def-weil-pbc-derived-categories; Q def-weil-abstract-derived-category; modules def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-pbc-sheafification. Claims moved out of the definition: that u_*F is a sheaf is the existing Lean-closed node lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous; additivity and left exactness on abelian sheaves are the new node lem-weil-pbc-direct-image-left-exact (unsplit, but proved sorry-free in slopmaster2: AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.lowerStar_additive, preservesLimitsOfShape_lowerStar, preservesFiniteLimits_lowerStar, recorded in its lean_audit as closed); on module sheaves (module structure through rho: R_V -> u_*R_U, additive, left exact) the new node lem-weil-pbc-module-direct-image-left-exact (unsplit). The derived functor: the source's 'set Ru_*K = u_*I(K)' hides that this is a functor on D^+ independent of the resolution; Ru_* is now the right derived functor of u_* on D^+ of the new Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-right-derived-plus-injective (Functor.rightDerivedFunctorPlus; isomorphic to u_* on bounded below complexes of injectives; unique up to unique isomorphism), and the formula Ru_*K = u_*I(K) for every K-injective resolution, and the action on morphisms through homotopy classes, follow from the existing Mathlib leaves lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative (bounded below injective representative, K-injective) and lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived (Hom into K-injective complexes computed in the homotopy category; quasi-isomorphisms between K-injective complexes are homotopy equivalences) plus additivity of u_*. Enough injectives: lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-enough-injectives (covers Ab and Mod(R)). R^qu_* = H^q(Ru_*) kept. The statement's meaning is unchanged; the module sentence is made precise (R_V constant, rho). Nodes of other units cited as notions/tools in this definition's statement: lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-continuous (Lean closed), lem-weil-pbc-etale-base-change-finite-limits, lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative, lem-weil-pbc-kinjective-hom-derived (Mathlib leaves), lem-weil-pbc-module-sheaves-enough-injectives (sk-thm-reduction, split).
